decisions.reason: The GA4 tracking plugin remains tightly aligned with the firm's analytics, shop-integration and plugin-development knowledge, so its high absorptive capacity and the now-standard market need around GA4 make withdrawal unlikely.

The retail system interface plugin fits the firm's existing customization and interface capabilities well enough to keep learning from client implementations, although connector-specific demand and maintenance complexity still create a moderate withdrawal risk.

SEO workshops build directly on the firm's established search-marketing expertise and reusable client knowledge, and as a low-asset service format they can be adapted commercially rather than removed unless demand proves clearly weak.
